title: armeria maritima subsp. legionensis
intro: Armeria maritima subsp. legionensis, commonly known as Legion Sea Thrift, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the family Plumbaginaceae. It is native to the Iberian Peninsula and is valued for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from various health issues such as inflammation, wounds, and skin problems due to its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Armeria maritima subsp. legionensis include soothing skin irritations, reducing inflammation, and promoting wound healing. Bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and iridoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and are responsible for its therapeutic actions.
